subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` plus its normalized event union as a permanent public plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive, but accepting it commits OpenClaw to an externally consumed parser/event API whose future compatibility cannot be determined mechanically.

options.title: Sponsor the SDK hook
options.body: Accept the plugin-owned JSONL parser direction, then require real registered-plugin proof and normal exact-head merge validation before landing.

options.title: Keep the surface internal
options.body: Decline the new public hook and route provider-specific rendering through an existing supported plugin or presentation seam instead.

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Specify a smaller stable event surface or a different SDK boundary before this implementation proceeds.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the SDK hook
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-owned JSONL parser direction, then require real registered-plugin proof and normal exact-head merge validation before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly includes this reviewer in the unresolved public SDK decision.
